title: A flaw has been found in OpenBMB Internet of Agents up to 9d78e88e47160eb42ee1ee8538c05e1c2c47877a. (CVE-2026-123675)
description: A code injection vulnerability exists in the execute_code function of the Code Executor Tool component in OpenBMB Internet of Agents up to commit 9d78e88e47160eb42ee1ee8538c05e1c2c47877a. The flaw is triggered by manipulation of the filename/lang argument and can be exploited remotely. Exploit code has been published. Due to the product's continuous delivery model with rolling releases, no specific affected or fixed versions are available. The project has been notified but has not yet responded.
